definitions.gloss: rapeseed flower, canola flower, field mustard flower
definitions.explanation: The bright yellow flowers of the rapeseed plant, strongly associated with spring in Japan. Also refers to the young shoots and buds of the plant eaten as a vegetable.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{菜|な}の{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く。
examples.english: Rapeseed flowers bloom when spring comes.

examples.japanese: {菜|な}の{花|はな}のおひたしは{春|はる}の{味|あじ}がする。
examples.english: Boiled rapeseed greens taste like spring.

examples.japanese: {一面|いちめん}に{広|ひろ}がる{菜|な}の{花|はな}{畑|ばたけ}は、この{地域|ちいき}の{春|はる}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}として{親|した}しまれている。
examples.english: The rapeseed flower fields stretching as far as the eye can see are beloved as a spring tradition in this region.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the iconic images of spring in Japan. Fields of bright yellow {菜|な}の{花|はな} are a popular sight for seasonal outings. The plant is also eaten as a spring vegetable, typically prepared as おひたし (boiled greens in dashi).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{菜|な}の{花|はな} appears in classical poetry and is a seasonal word ({季語|きご}) for spring in haiku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菜|な}の{花|はな}{畑|ばたけ}: rapeseed flower field
- {菜|な}の{花|はな}のおひたし: boiled rapeseed greens
